tasks.title: Verify rules, rights, eligibility and available resources
acceptance_tests: All hard constraints have an official source or explicit blocker.
No unapproved budget is recorded as authorized.
AI development assistance, publishing rights and prize-specific remote fulfillment reviewed by owner.

tasks.title: Freeze schemas, repository layout and test harness
acceptance_tests: Schema rejects unknown task IDs and invalid budgets.
Mock status is propagated through API/UI/export.
Typed interfaces build and contract tests pass.

tasks.title: Author independently reviewed fixture suite and split
acceptance_tests: 60 validated tasks across 12 repos; 20/10/30 repo-disjoint split.
Gold patch passes and faulty starting version fails intended oracle.
No final tests/gold patches are accessible from repair workspace.

tasks.title: Implement and smoke-test sponsor adapters
acceptance_tests: Two real authorized cases record actual model and operation IDs.
Cancellation propagates and billing records reconcile.
No credentials present in candidate workspace.
Unavailable controls cause explicit blocked status.

tasks.title: Implement matched-model baseline
acceptance_tests: Same task statement, requirements, model and aggregate limits as proposed system.
Failed episodes and retries retained.
Pinned dependency/source notices present.

tasks.title: Implement protected acceptance checks and clean evaluation
acceptance_tests: Protected-path changes rejected.
Fresh workspace independently reproduces test verdict.
Test errors and unverified requirements never become pass.

tasks.title: Add bounded candidate branches and selection
acceptance_tests: At most three branches share one fixed total budget.
No final-test feedback reaches selection.
Checks-only ablation disables branching without other changes.

tasks.title: Add evidence journal, export and replay
acceptance_tests: Every declared check maps to requirement and log digest.
Tampered manifest/diff/log fails replay validation.
Measured and estimated costs distinguishable.

tasks.title: Run pilot and issue continuation decision
acceptance_tests: 72 planned pilot episodes accounted for.
Task-level comparison and failed-run handling correct.
G2 threshold met or written simplify/stop decision issued.

tasks.title: Build task, comparison and evidence UI
acceptance_tests: Task selection to evidence export works without coaching.
Live, replay and mock states visibly distinct.
No arbitrary code/URL input or accidental write action.

tasks.title: Run sealed evaluation, ablations and review exercises
acceptance_tests: 30 tasks × 3 variants × 3 repetitions accounted for.
Repo-clustered paired analysis; identical budgets and task information.
No unsupported superiority claim when uncertainty or ablation contradicts it.

tasks.title: Test complete workflow and bounded public-demo operation
acceptance_tests: Timeout, denial, replay, cancellation and restart tests pass.
Demo cannot reach private network or expose keys.
Availability/operating budget through required judging date planned.

tasks.title: Prepare real demo and submission assets
acceptance_tests: Demo under 170 seconds target, no fictitious results.
Claims trace to actual reports and evidence.
Working product and clean source match the shown version.

tasks.title: Independent release audit and owner handoff
acceptance_tests: Fresh environment reproduces selected runs.
Final rules rechecked, licenses audited and secrets absent.
Owner controls publication/entry; automation did not enroll or submit.
